This editorial illustration features a purple gradient background. At the top, the large white word "TEMPO" sits below a solid red horizontal bar. Below the masthead, two men walk toward the right. On the left, a man in a dark suit and white shirt walks forward. Behind him and slightly to the right, a taller man in a light blue short-sleeved button-up shirt and grey trousers walks in the same direction. Both men’s shadows stretch across the ground in front of them. These long, dark shadows undergo a literal transformation, turning into red fabric carpets that are rolled up at their distal ends. 

The text "BUKAN SEKADAR CALON BAN SEREP" appears in large white letters on the right. Smaller text includes "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU", "8-14 MEI 2023", "Untung-Rugi Divestasi Vale H.74", "ChatGPT di Industri Kreatif H.36", and a paragraph mentioning "Sandiaga Uno," "Erick Thohir," and "Pemilu 2024. H.20." A barcode and QR code are located in the top-right corner near the date and price information.
